image_description: The image depicts the interior of a large, historic prison block, likely Alcatraz or a similar panopticon-style facility. It features a long central corridor with high arched ceilings and skylights. On both sides, there are two levels of cell blocks with iron railings and barred doors. Several people (tourists) are walking through the corridor in the foreground and mid-ground. The architecture is utilitarian, constructed of brick and painted metal/stone.

The texture of the floor appears slightly smudged or painterly upon close inspection, lacking the sharp grout lines and wear patterns of real stone tiles.

If the text is completely nonsensical, it confirms AI generation despite high visual fidelity. Also, scrutinize the hands and feet of the people in the foreground for subtle deformation or fusion with the floor/railings.
